title: A Sudden Resurrection
hook: The very first ghazal of Rumi's Divan opens with a resurrection.

segments.fa: ای رستخیز ناگهان وی رحمت بی‌منتها
segments.en: O sudden resurrection, O mercy without end,

segments.fa: ای آتشی افروخته در بیشهٔ اندیشه‌ها
segments.en: O fire set ablaze in the forest of thoughts.

tafsir: Rastakhiz is the Day of Resurrection, when the dead rise.
Rumi gives that name to the Beloved.
One reading: when love arrives, a dead heart stands up again.
And the fire burns through the thick forest of our worries.
This week in our serial, Rumi's death is called a wedding.

outro.say: Shams and Rumi, the serial, is on our page. Follow The Guest House.
